systems.name: Flywheel
systems.purpose: Serve as the primary platform for model-neutral agent work: engine, desktop client, gated tool use, receipt-backed inference, and extension lanes.
systems.entryCommand: pip install flywheel-verify; flywheel up

evidence.label: Flywheel v0.3.10
evidence.summary: The v0.3.10 public release is current, and the public GitHub description identifies Flywheel as the one platform for the engine and native desktop client.

limitations: Receipts establish witnessed actions and checks, not general model correctness.
Local weights and optional signing or monitoring features have separate installation requirements.
systems.boundary: Use model routes, tools, data, and environments only with the authority required by their owners and providers.

systems.name: Telos
systems.purpose: Provide a local MCP workbench for creation, simulation, workstation interaction, and re-checkable proof packets.
systems.entryCommand: node demo/run.mjs

evidence.label: Telos public source
evidence.summary: The public repository is active on main; the latest tagged release is v0.1.0 while source identifies the newer Telos 0.2.0 pre-1.0 workbench.

limitations: Pre-1.0 interfaces may change.
A research packet does not by itself prove causal discovery, robot safety, or hardware fault-tolerance claims.
systems.boundary: Workstation actions and external effects remain subject to explicit operator authority and tool-specific gates.

systems.name: Index
systems.purpose: Build offline repository and workspace maps, dependency graphs, symbols, and bounded context artifacts from file-line evidence.
systems.entryCommand: pip install index-graph; index wiki --root <repo-path> --out wiki.html

evidence.label: Index v2.9.0
evidence.summary: The v2.9.0 release is verified; newer beta source metadata is not presented as a stable release.

limitations: Dynamic imports and unsupported structures can remain incomplete or unverifiable.
Structural evidence does not guarantee the accuracy of explanatory prose.
systems.boundary: Inspect only repositories and workspaces you are authorized to read.

systems.name: Gather
systems.purpose: Capture web, scholarly, document, browser, OCR, video, and audio material into provenance-bearing research records.
systems.entryCommand: pip install gather-engine; gather extract https://example.com/article

evidence.label: Gather v1.6.1
evidence.summary: The v1.6.1 public release was verified.

limitations: Static web mode does not execute JavaScript.
Optional hard-source adapters require external tools, and untrusted URLs near internal services require separate network controls.
systems.boundary: Respect access controls, copyright, privacy, and the terms governing each source.

systems.name: Forum
systems.purpose: Route and run agent fleets with budgets, approval gates, checkpoints, and a causal ledger.
systems.entryCommand: pip install forum-engine; forum route "build the requested system"

evidence.label: Forum v1.13.0
evidence.summary: The v1.13.0 public release was verified.

limitations: A valid ledger proves recorded integrity and replayability, not that model output is substantively correct.
Executors and human approval policy remain operator-supplied.
systems.boundary: Agent permissions must remain no broader than the operator's authority and the active task scope.

systems.name: Crucible
systems.purpose: Test falsifiable claims against supplied measurements and emit MATCH, DRIFT, or UNVERIFIABLE outcomes.
systems.entryCommand: pip install crucible-bench; python examples/demo.py

evidence.label: Crucible v1.2.0
evidence.summary: The v1.2.0 public release was verified.

limitations: Verdict quality cannot exceed the supplied substrate, measurement, tolerance, and criterion.
Missing or ill-posed evidence fails closed.
systems.boundary: Do not present a verdict as stronger than the evidence and criterion that produced it.

systems.name: EMET
systems.purpose: Re-derive byte consistency and portable integrity receipts across independent language implementations.
systems.entryCommand: pip install emet

evidence.label: EMET v1.2.0
evidence.summary: The v1.2.0 public release was verified.

limitations: The witness reports byte agreement, drift, or inability to verify; it does not judge semantic quality.
Same-author conformance implementations prove rule clarity, not independent authorship.
systems.boundary: Run on files and packets you are authorized to inspect.

systems.name: BuildLang
systems.purpose: Compile systems programs with typed capability effects, C interoperability, native C-path binaries, and shader targets.
systems.entryCommand: cargo install buildlang; buildc run examples/quickstart/hello.bld

evidence.label: BuildLang v1.2.0
evidence.summary: The v1.2.0 public release was verified.

limitations: C is the production backend.
SPIR-V, LLVM, WebAssembly, Rust, native-object backends, GPU compute, and linear types retain experimental scope.
systems.boundary: Generated programs inherit the authority and safety obligations of the capabilities they exercise.

systems.name: Learn
systems.purpose: Turn operator-provided material into study plans and course workflows with spaced practice and re-verifiable receipts.
systems.entryCommand: npm install -g @harperz9/learn; learn tutor study mysession

evidence.label: Learn public source
evidence.summary: The public repository identifies Learn 1.6.0 package source; no GitHub release is claimed.

limitations: Automation halts at graded, consent, CAPTCHA, payment, and account-creation steps.
Mastery derives only from the learner's witnessed attempts.
systems.boundary: The learner remains responsible for graded answers, consent, identity, and institutional rules.

systems.name: Relay
systems.purpose: Provide a zero-dependency coding agent for local, subscription, API, and cloud endpoints with permission gates and a hash-chained run ledger.
systems.entryCommand: pip install git+https://github.com/HarperZ9/relay.git; relay --health --online

evidence.label: Relay public source
evidence.summary: The public main branch identifies Relay 0.1.0; no GitHub release is claimed.

limitations: The command denylist is not a security boundary.
A valid trajectory proves recorded actions, not that edits are correct; acceptance needs an operator-owned check.
systems.boundary: Tool use remains permission-checked and limited to authorized repositories, systems, and endpoints.

systems.name: Plexus
systems.purpose: Discover declared tool capabilities and derive inspectable producer-consumer wiring plans.
systems.entryCommand: pip install git+https://github.com/HarperZ9/plexus.git; plexus discover --builtin
systems.verificationCommand: plexus plan --goal crucible --builtin > plan.json; plexus verify --plan plan.json --builtin

evidence.label: Plexus public source
evidence.summary: The public main branch identifies Plexus 0.2.0; no GitHub release is claimed.

limitations: Plexus does not execute or probe tools.
Edges and source pointers are declared claims, not observed interoperability.
systems.boundary: A wiring plan does not grant authority to execute any connected capability.

systems.name: Mneme
systems.purpose: Provide layered agent memory with provenance, reproducible hybrid recall, drift detection, and audited forgetting.
systems.entryCommand: pip install git+https://github.com/HarperZ9/mneme.git; mneme recall "where does the user live" --json

evidence.label: Mneme public source
evidence.summary: The public source is newer than the latest v0.1.0 release, so no untagged version is presented as released.

limitations: Source recheck remains Mneme-owned rather than independently re-read by Crucible.
Replay rejects ambiguous SQLite sidecar or hardlink state.
systems.boundary: Store and recall only information the operator is authorized to retain and process.

systems.name: Studio Engine
systems.purpose: Generate deterministic shader, sound, motion, preview, and receipt-bearing creative-world packets.
systems.entryCommand: python -m studio_engine 7 gyroid

evidence.label: Studio Engine public source
evidence.summary: The public main branch identifies Studio Engine 0.2.0; no GitHub release is claimed.

limitations: Studio Engine is not presented as a finished product.
Browsers, GPUs, and audio hosts realize its programs; the native renderer is optional and APIs may move before 1.0.
systems.boundary: Generated media must respect the rights, licenses, and consent attached to its inputs and intended use.

systems.name: Build Color
systems.purpose: Provide a software color-science workbench for spaces, color difference, adaptation, HDR, gamut, spectra, ICC, and LUT workflows.
systems.entryCommand: pip install .; build-color info ff6030

evidence.label: Build Color v1.0.1
evidence.summary: The latest public release is v1.0.1; newer 1.0.2 source metadata remains beta.

limitations: The workbench measures digital color behavior; it is not a physical display instrument.
The GUI and fuller numerical stack require optional dependencies.
systems.boundary: Do not represent software output as physical-instrument evidence without an actual calibrated instrument.

systems.name: Retro Engine
systems.purpose: Serve as the Retro Systems Lab play pillar: an interactive browser studio for owned pixel, palette, shader, and CRT experiments.
systems.entryCommand: Open retro.html in a browser.
systems.verificationCommand: npm run routes:check; npm run systems:check; npm run system-pages:check

evidence.label: Retro Engine owned site source
evidence.summary: The owned public site source contains the browser Retro Engine route and renderer assets; this is not BRender evidence.

limitations: Retro Engine output is generic creative output and does not prove any BRender restoration fact.
Browser, GPU, and font rendering can differ by host, so captures are bounded media evidence rather than performance claims.
systems.boundary: Use only owned or licensed input media and do not present generated retro visuals as archival proof for another repository.

systems.name: Engine Revival
systems.purpose: Serve as the Retro Systems Lab preserve pillar: a public MIT evidence spine for historical engine and rendering-library revival records.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; engine-revival seed; engine-revival validate

evidence.label: Engine Revival v0.1.0
evidence.summary: The public main and v0.1.0 release resolve to 0af6d527860a63c418b5775dc0efe9ba89557604. Engine Revival is MIT; it records local 12-target materializer scope separately from imported external 21-target BRender evidence.

limitations: Engine Revival local 12-target materializer scope is public metadata and scaffold; the verified external 21-target BRender boundary comes from BRender Archival v0.1.1 evidence.
The page preserves evidence boundaries and does not claim product parity, adoption, performance, legal completeness, or vendored upstream source.
systems.boundary: Publish only repository metadata and restoration facts that have current first-party receipts, and keep imported AGPL-covered BRender media and receipts distinct from MIT repository code.

systems.name: BRender Archival
systems.purpose: Serve as the Retro Systems Lab verify pillar: a specific BRender restoration surface that stays separate from generic Retro Engine media.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; engine-revival seed; engine-revival validate

evidence.label: BRender Archival v0.1.1
evidence.summary: The public main and v0.1.1 release resolve to 11b5a8d539e911a9c07991b751402a7d51bf1bde. The repo is AGPL-3.0-or-later, upstream BRender MIT is referenced not vendored, and 21/21 native CTest targets are recorded.

limitations: Specific BRender restoration proof must come from BRender evidence, not from Retro Engine screenshots or generic retro visuals.
The release does not claim completed textured TIA output, x64 readiness, production readiness, adoption, endorsement, or vendored upstream source or assets.
systems.boundary: Keep BRender restoration evidence, Retro Engine play output, and Engine Revival preservation status distinct.

systems.name: Proof Surface
systems.purpose: Provide default-deny authorization checks, bounded delegation, and reviewable proof packets for agent actions.

evidence.label: Proof Surface public source 0.2.0
evidence.summary: Public source identifies version 0.2.0; no release claim is made.

limitations: Proof Surface recommends authorization decisions; the surrounding system performs enforcement.
Public source 0.2.0 does not establish independent adversarial review or production safety.
systems.boundary: Use only with explicit human authority; a recommendation does not itself grant permission.

systems.name: Elder ENB
systems.purpose: Provide a public graphics configuration and runtime integration surface for Elder Scrolls ENB workflows.

evidence.label: Elder ENB public source 0.1.0
evidence.summary: Public source identifies version 0.1.0 and latest tag v1.0.0-rc.5; no release claim is made.

limitations: Final live ENB acceptance remains a limitation.
The latest tag v1.0.0-rc.5 is not presented as a release.
systems.boundary: Use only with the game, runtime, and asset rights required by their owners.

systems.name: Truth ENB
systems.purpose: Provide a public ENB graphics configuration surface for reviewable visual-runtime workflows.

evidence.label: Truth ENB public source 1.0.0
evidence.summary: Public source identifies version 1.0.0 and latest tag v1.0.0-rc.1; no release claim is made.

limitations: The latest tag v1.0.0-rc.1 is not presented as a release.
Visual output depends on the host game, ENB runtime, and local graphics environment.
systems.boundary: Use only with the game, runtime, and asset rights required by their owners.

systems.name: ENB Runtime Core
systems.purpose: Provide a public runtime core for ENB integration components that operate inside an already-loaded host.

evidence.label: ENB Runtime Core public source 0.1.0
evidence.summary: Public source identifies version 0.1.0; no release claim is made.

limitations: Requires an already-loaded ENBSeries host.
Public source 0.1.0 is not presented as a release.
systems.boundary: Use only with a permitted host runtime and the rights required by its owners.

systems.name: SkyrimBridge
systems.purpose: Provide a public bridge between Skyrim-facing integration workflows and reviewable graphics-runtime components.

evidence.label: SkyrimBridge public source 3.0.0
evidence.summary: Public source identifies version 3.0.0 and latest tag v3.0.0-rc.1; no release claim is made.

limitations: The public/default build excludes the native replacement suite.
The latest tag v3.0.0-rc.1 is not presented as a release.
systems.boundary: Use only with the game, runtime, and asset rights required by their owners.

systems.name: Phantom
systems.purpose: Audit and change reversible hardware-identity surfaces on owned or expressly authorized Windows and Linux systems, with backup and revert.
systems.entryCommand: Download a v1.1.0 release asset and compare its hash with SHA256SUMS.txt.

evidence.label: Phantom v1.1.0
evidence.summary: The public release exposes v1.1.0 assets for Windows and Linux.

limitations: Phantom covers Layer 2 identity surfaces; kernel and firmware layers are modeled but not shipped end to end.
The Windows installer is unsigned, and platform controls differ between Windows and Linux.
systems.boundary: Use only on machines you own or are expressly authorized to test; do not use it for fraud, anti-cheat targeting, or unauthorized access.

systems.name: behavior-transform.io
systems.purpose: Provide a public IO-boundary implementation for read, write, execution, fetch, input, and model-boundary receipts.

evidence.label: behavior-transform.io public source
evidence.summary: A public main branch exists; no tagged release, supported install command, or production adoption is claimed.

limitations: No tagged release or publicly verified entry command is claimed.
A boundary receipt records declared policy and observed IO; it does not guarantee provider acceptance or substantive safety.
systems.boundary: Use the boundary only within the operator's authority and governing provider, data-owner, and system policies.

systems.name: Authorized Private Security Practice
systems.purpose: Provide controlled offensive-security, adversarial-AI, and high-consequence review through private, written-scope engagements without publishing operational capability.

evidence.label: Public engagement boundary
evidence.summary: The public page groups private capability families without distributing protected methods.

limitations: No private repository, operational method, target detail, client fact, or engagement result is published.
No third-party acceptance, deployment, or outcome is claimed.
systems.boundary: Written authorization, a defined scope, secure intake, and engagement-specific review are required before any private capability, protected test material, recipient-specific method, or version-sensitive finding is discussed or used.

systems.name: Accountable Surface
systems.purpose: Provide a controlled agent-action workbench with structural perception, default-deny grants, bounded effectors, re-perception, rollback, and a durable journal.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; python examples/demo.py

evidence.label: Accountable Surface public source
evidence.summary: The public repository identifies source 0.1.0 and no tagged release; self-authored tests are not independent review.

limitations: The model cannot supply its own authorization.
Self-authored tests do not establish independent adversarial review or production safety.
systems.boundary: Every effect requires authority external to the model and remains limited to the granted scope.

systems.name: Public Surface Sweeper
systems.purpose: Audit required public files, text hygiene, secret-shaped values, and proof-packet readiness.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install public-surface-sweeper; public-surface-sweeper . --summary
systems.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; public-surface-sweeper examples/clean-repo; python -m pytest

evidence.label: Public Surface Sweeper v0.1.1
evidence.summary: The latest tagged release is v0.1.1; newer source metadata is not presented as released.

limitations: This is not an exploit tester, dependency vulnerability scanner, credential validator, compliance certification, or replacement for security review.
A secret-shaped finding does not establish that the value is a live credential.
systems.boundary: Scan only repositories and artifacts you are authorized to inspect.

systems.name: Model Provenance Validator
systems.purpose: Validate provenance-envelope schema and redact secret-shaped output.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install model-provenance-validator; model-provenance-validator examples/envelopes/release.provenance.json
systems.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; model-provenance-validator examples/envelopes/release.provenance.json; python -m pytest

evidence.label: Model Provenance Validator v0.1.1
evidence.summary: The v0.1.1 public release was verified.

limitations: The validator does not fetch sources, decide underlying truth, prove model safety, certify provenance, or replace human review.
systems.boundary: Validate only public or authorized envelopes and keep protected source evidence outside public output.

systems.name: Secret Redact IO
systems.purpose: Provide guarded Python IO helpers that redact file, fetch, write, and subprocess output while emitting hash-only receipts.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install secret-redact-io; secret-redact-io read README.md --json

evidence.label: Secret Redact IO v0.1.0
evidence.summary: The v0.1.0 public release was verified.

limitations: The package does not include credentials or environment configuration.
Redaction and hash-only receipts reduce exposure but do not replace source review.
systems.boundary: Do not pass secrets to destinations that are not authorized to receive them, even when redaction is enabled.

systems.name: Agent Hook Pack
systems.purpose: Install public-safe hooks for secret checks, branch guards, environment synchronization, and repository hygiene.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install -e .; agent-hook-pack audit; agent-hook-pack list
systems.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; agent-hook-pack audit; python -m pytest

evidence.label: Agent Hook Pack v0.1.0
evidence.summary: The v0.1.0 public release was verified.

limitations: Private policy layers are intentionally omitted from the public package.
Generic hooks cannot prove a repository or agent workflow is safe.
systems.boundary: Hooks support, but do not replace, repository-specific policy and human review.

systems.name: Repo Proof Index
systems.purpose: Index proof packets, receipts, and contracts into reviewer-ready summaries without making approval decisions.
systems.entryCommand: python -m pip install repo-proof-index; repo-proof-index contracts/*.json --summary
systems.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; repo-proof-index examples/contracts/*.json --summary; python -m pytest

evidence.label: Repo Proof Index v0.1.1
evidence.summary: The v0.1.1 public release was verified.

limitations: The index does not decide whether evidence is sufficient, validate arbitrary schemas, or read referenced private payloads.
systems.boundary: Index only public or authorized evidence and keep private payloads outside public summaries.
